newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says still to be part of first EMU wave.
newsitem.headline: Spain says still to be part of first EMU wave.

text.p: Spain said on Wednesday it still expects to be among the first wave of European countries that launch the common currency.
"We maintain the idea that Spain will enter with the first group of countries in the common currency," a government spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesman was responding to a report in the Financial Times of a possible face-saving deal to delay entry of some countries like Italy, Spain and Portugal until 2000 or 2001.
He said the government had no knowledge of such a deal.
Spain's Foreign Minister Abel Matutes said on Tuesday that Spain and Italy were on course to join EMU from the start on January 1, 1999.
